## Release boundary
- [ ] No real patient data or secrets
- [ ] No unreviewed dependency/data/model/rights incorporation
- [ ] No silent clinical approval, patient consent, treatment selection or real action
- [ ] Shared contract and overlapping PRs reconciled
- [ ] Human approval recorded for RED changes
- [ ] Merge/release only through separately configured protected branch process
